Built with React.createElement (the output path must stay `index.ts`, which cannot contain JSX). No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imported; only React, react-native StyleSheet, and the shared native AppText/GlassPanel + theme spacing tokens are used.

Prop interfaces mirror the web sibling prop names using permissive structural types (ObjectLike, NumberToNumber) so future native call sites compile unchanged; no `any` used. The source barrel has no i18n strings, so the short placeholder labels are native scaffolding, not source-derived copy.
Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`.
